headline: Organizational meeting with membership introductions and election of officers, plus discussion of bylaws and outreach initiatives.
summary: Members will be introduced and officers elected. The agenda also includes discussion of bylaws and outreach initiatives.
items: Membership introductions and election of officers
location: Walter Stiles Room, 2nd Floor, Manchester City Hall, One City Hall Plaza

1. Call to Order.

3. Organizational Meeting: Membership Introductions and Election of Officers.

6. Review of Prior Meeting Minutes. 
7. Staff Update. 
8. Other Business.
